title: SBRP
body:
## Description
Made with catharsis revolutionary — Resoursepack with models and textures for diffirent kind of content.
We trying to do cool and maintaining a recognizable style.
## Features
### Models
Diana mobs(WIP)

### Textures
Diana items
Wither blades
AOTV/AOTE
SB menu star

### Config
All textures are toggleable by catharsis.
### Other info
We have 2 kind of versions .cats and .rar | .cats - faster then .rar
